scientific_integrity: The all-N claim is proved algebraically via global Pauli identities and a quadratic Walsh identity; exact finite checks are supplementary. No human or independent validation represented.
scientific_limitations: Only the full-coupling all-to-all Floquet gate with angle pi/4 and all N>=2. Finite-size checker is not an infinite proof. No integrability classification or perturbation robustness follows. Full 2024 follow-up article not read; originality risk disclosed.
title: All-size exact Floquet operator orders for an infinite-range Ising drive
